[F013] Verification is complete. Here's what I found and confirmed.

**Target context** — Repo: DontPanic · Env: dev · Project: (none)

Commands I ran (all read-only verification — no mutating/side-effect calls):
```
$ python -m pytest scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_dashboard_inventory_f013.py -q
$ npx vitest run tests/unit/config-inventory-logic.test.js tests/integration/config-inventory-page.test.js tests/unit/settings-logic.test.js   (cwd=dashboard)
$ git log/status/ls-files (state inspection)
```

F013 is already fully implemented and committed (`1e43160 feat(onboarding-v0): F013 dashboard live-path`), with a clean working tree, so my role this iteration was to verify the feature against its acceptance criteria rather than re-author it. All four behaviors are in place and exercised by green tests: (AC1) `dashboard.build()`/`write_config_inventory()` render the F008 `collect_inventory()` output as Settings/Setup cards via `to_dashboard_state()` — 19 providers, well over the ≥10 bar; (AC2) `_detect_dashboard_hint()` auto-detects a running singleton through `dashboard.detect_active_url()` and falls back to the start command with no caller-supplied `dashboard_url`; (AC3) exactly one response-level `DashboardHint` is attached and human-required items only carry a `dashboard_hint_ref`; (AC4) `_item_to_card()` separates the validated `safe_command` edit affordance from a distinct `run_action`, and `_is_run_action_command()` guarantees no build/start/serve verb is ever emitted
